knowledge:
- key_parameters: idx=A vector of column indices to plot (e.g., idx=c(1,3)) ;; classlab=A vector of class labels to customize cluster assignment in plots ;; drawboundary=Logical flag to draw the final cluster boundaries ;; drawvor=Logical flag to draw the Voronoi boundaries of K-means ;; drawkmeans=Logical flag to draw K-means cluster centers ;; drawlab=Logical flag to draw cluster labels ;; method=The evaluation metric used in evalCluster (e.g., "Vmeasure")
- alternatives: Finite mixture models and histogram spatial exploration, which flowPeaks combines and improves upon for high-dimensional data.
- when_to_use: When you need fast, automatic, and unsupervised clustering of flow cytometry data, especially when clusters have irregular shapes or contain outliers.
- pitfalls: Automatic color specification in plots is not unique for all clusters, so users may need to manually adjust the col option. Cluster boundaries and Voronoi cells are only visible in 2D plots; they are not visible for higher-dimensional clustering due to overlap in 2D projections. Compiling the package from source requires external GSL (GNU Scientific Library) dependencies.

workflows.name: matrix_clustering_and_evaluation
workflows.intent: Cluster a numeric matrix of flow cytometry data, visualize the results in 2D/pairwise plots, evaluate cluster performance against a gold standard, and identify outliers.
input: barcode (a numeric matrix or data frame representing flow cytometry measurements)
barcode.cid (a vector of gold standard cluster IDs for evaluation)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and data ;; 2. Run flowPeaks clustering on the full matrix ;; 3. Plot 2D and pairwise projections of the clustering results ;; 4. Run flowPeaks clustering on selected dimensions ;; 5. Evaluate clustering performance against a gold standard using evalCluster ;; 6. Identify and assign outliers using assign.flowPeaks and re-plot
workflows.code:
library(flowPeaks)
data(barcode)
summary(barcode)
fp<-flowPeaks(barcode)
plot(fp,idx=c(1,3))
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(fp,idx=c(1,2,3))
fp2<-flowPeaks(barcode[,c(1,3)])
plot(fp2)
evalCluster(barcode.cid,fp2$peaks.cluster,method="Vmeasure")
fpc<-assign.flowPeaks(fp2,fp2$x)
plot(fp2,classlab=fpc,drawboundary=FALSE,
  drawvor=FALSE,drawkmeans=FALSE,drawlab=TRUE)

workflows.name: flowframe_clustering
workflows.intent: Cluster flow cytometry data imported as a flowFrame object from the flowCore package.
input: 0877408774.B08 (an FCS file containing flow cytometry data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load flowCore and read the FCS file into a flowFrame ;; 2. Extract and transform the expression matrix using asinh ;; 3. Run flowPeaks clustering on the transformed expression data ;; 4. Plot the clustering results
